lines.en: label christmastwo8:
scene christmaskaraoke1
A scene not at all dissimilar from many I’ve witnessed in the past- accompanied by scent of various baked goods and...alcohol?
Oh well. I guess if my students are going to start recreationally drinking, it’s better if I’m around them or-
scene dodgingsnowflakes18
scene christmaskaraoke1
Anyway, it looks like Yasu is doing fine, so I will now label my mission from Touka as complete and hope she does not misplace my present and make me look worse than I already am.
Which is pretty bad since I’ve already had sex with a decent portion of this room.
: I am impressed by your ability to accurately replicate this song, Strawberry Princess.
: Every time I have attempted to sing, it has ended in tragedy.
: I believe the Emerald Guardian has said something about multiple notes being required, while I only know one of them.
Ami doesn’t respond to Tsuneyo on account of her undying desire to always be the center of someone’s attention and just keeps singing away at some song I’m sure I’ve heard playing in her room before.
The song doesn’t really have anything to do with Christmas, but it’s not like I’m complaining about that.
Frankly, Christmas music joins the ranks of things like the obligation to buy presents or...bright lights as yet one more characteristic that makes this time of year hard to deal with.
Speaking of things that are hard to deal with, maybe I should try and see if Yasu is at least...conscious.
She’s been standing as still as a statue for as long as I’ve been looking at her- which is a vast departure from her seemingly inherent desire to always wander around when she’s not busy “praying.”
Oh. Maybe that’s it.
Maybe this is just another example of some ridiculous religious practice that I neither want to nor have the mental capacity to understand.
Yeah. That’s it.
My mission really is complete after all.
Okay, I’m going to go talk to someone else before staring at her any longer begins to rot my brain.
scene black
scene christmaskaraoke2
: Sensei! What a pleasant surprise! I totally haven’t spent the entire day waiting for you to get here or anything!
: The entire day? You were literally at my house this morning.
scene christmaskaraoke3
: Yeah, about that! Why did you lock your door?! I wanted to come say good morning!
: To prevent you from sneaking into my bedroom in the middle of the night, obviously.
scene christmaskaraoke4
: Ohhhh, I see. You were just worried you wouldn’t get any sleep on account of-
: Ahem.
I clear my throat and make an obvious gesture toward Karin, who is becoming increasingly uncomfortable with the direction this conversation is beginning to head in.
scene christmaskaraoke5
: On account of all of the Christmas movies we were supposed to watch together, obviously!
: Ah! You guys were going to watch Christmas movies?! I used to watch those with Kirin all the time before she...
scene christmaskaraoke6
: Decided she didn’t like me anymore...
: Uhh...
: You can...watch them with us next year?
: Ayane, why are you making plans for next Christmas in the middle of the current one?
scene christmaskaraoke7
: I panicked! You saw how sad she looked!
: Besides, you never know when time might get all weird and like...start over or something!
: I...would love watching movies with you guys, but...I don’t know if I’d...want to watch them in...S...S...S-
: Sensei’s room. Ayane, what did you just say?
scene christmaskaraoke8
: Hm? The time thing?
: Yeah. Say it again.
: That...we never know when time might start over?
: I wasn’t being serious, but...you look really interested all of a sudden.
: So it’s just a random thought that popped into your head? There’s no...deeper meaning or anything?
scene christmaskaraoke9
: Are...you interested in time travel, Sensei?
: If...time travel is even what we’re talking about, I mean. I’m having an admittedly hard time following right now.
: Not particularly. Ayane just said something that sounded a little strange to me, is all.
Especially considering the last time there actually was a reset, Ayane showed up halfway through only to subsequently disappear a few minutes later.
scene christmaskaraoke10
: I say strange things all of the time. It’s like, a cornerstone of my bubbly, rambunctious personality. How come this one is the one you single out as being “too weird?”
: All things considered, I think it’s one of the more...tame things I’ve said.
: What if I told you that you’re not far from the truth, though?
scene christmaskaraoke11
: Are you asking me what I’d do if we only had a brief amount of time left before the world started over? Because the answer is simple, Sensei!
: I’d make you mine and stop worrying about other people getting in the way! And spend every single second with you until my random time prediction came true!
: Then, I’d do it all over again from the beginning, knowing full-well that the world is on a repeating cycle!
: Like I said, it’s simple! What else would you expect me to do in a world where the two of us are infinite?
: Maybe freak out a little more about the idea of circular time but, you know, I realize now that this was just wishful thinking on my part.
scene christmaskaraoke12
: I’m not sure where this sudden fascination with the weird things I say came from, but I’m just going to chalk it up to you falling more in love with me if that’s okay.
: And I’m...also here still...
: Would you like to share your thoughts on the concept of time, Karin? Quietly, though, so Maya doesn’t overhear anything and suddenly get invested.
scene christmaskaraoke13
: I’ve...never really thought about it...
: And I definitely didn’t expect to be talking about it at a Christmas party, but...
scene christmaskaraoke14
: I think...time is...
: Neat?...
: Well said, Karin! I think my infinite love story was a little more interesting, though. But I’m sure that if you keep working hard, you’ll find someone you love as much as I love Sensei one day.
: Then, you can have your own infinite love story!
scene christmaskaraoke15
: HAHAHAHA! L-L-L-LOVE! FUNNY JOKE, AYANE!
scene christmaskaraoke16
: Why...did I just yell that?
: Umm...anyway, what do you plan on doing for the rest of the night, Sensei? Just going to walk around and maaaaybe think of your favorite rich girl all night or something?
: I already talked to Touka today. I don’t have to think about her anymore.
scene christmaskaraoke17
: Hey! That’s mean! I didn’t realize this was a category I actually had to compete in! I love you way more than Touka ever will!
: I’ve even been holding onto this crisp, refreshing bottle of Coca-Cola for you ever since I got here!
: To prove my love!
scene christmaskaraoke18
: Nothing says love like sharing a Coke.
scene christmaskaraoke19
: Okay. Well, I’m going to go see how a significantly shorter group of girls is doing and...I guess I’ll see you two around.
: Okay! We’re not going anywhere, so feel free to drop by whenever you want.
: Also, if that whole time thing really does start happening and you want to embark on our epic journey of romance and handholding, please don’t hesitate to contact me!
: Ayane Amamiya is open 24/7 when it comes to her beloved teacher slash future husband.
: And...uhh...I will...also be here...
scene black
I step away from Ayane and Karin and help myself to a crisp, refreshing Coca-Cola on the way across the room.
The group of girls crowding around the karaoke machine has since increased in size with Uta and Touka (Who managed to slip inside without me noticing) forming a small semi-circle around my [niece].
It will only be a matter of time until Ami is forced to stop singing and surrender the microphone to one of the others, though.
And even though the amount of attention she’s receiving right now should sustain her for the next several hours or so, I’m sure she’ll find another way to feed off of all of our energy soon enough.
scene christmaskaraoke20
: Merry Christmas, Sensei! Thank you for another year of making sure I don’t have to learn anythin’ in class!
: Another year?
: Hm? S’at a weird thing to say?
scene christmaskaraoke21
: I think he...means since...he’s only been our teacher for one...
: Really? I guess time really does fly when ‘yer havin’ fun, then.
: Speaking of fun, do you know what I think would be fun, Miku? Not looking at Touka all night.
scene christmaskaraoke22
: But you love lookin’ at girls! ‘Specially ones with massive dohoonkabhankoloos.
: I like staring at all girls equally, thank you very much. I just mean that you in particular shouldn’t look at her.
scene christmaskaraoke23
: Uh...you mind if I ask why? Or is that gonna somehow ruin all of the fun you think I’ll have ignorin’ a classmate?
: She’s just carrying a thing you’re not allowed to see. It wouldn’t have been an issue if I had just followed the rules- but rules are for losers.
: I still don’t get it, but I’ll trust ya. Whaddya want me to do if she tries to talk to me, though?
: I don’t know. Talk about being poor or something. That might scare her away.
: But...Touka has been...getting a lot better about...um...accepting us...non-rich people...
: You’re all getting better at all sorts of things, but you’ll still always have your weaknesses.
: Uh-oh. Sensei’s goin’ into life lesson mode. Put back on your earmuffs, Sana.
scene christmaskaraoke24
: I’m not going into any mode. I just think it’s beneficial to never expect anyone to fully recover from the things that bring them down.
: It’s why I’d never send Sana out to buy lunch for me and why I’d never put you in a loud-
: Wait, how are you doing right now, Miku?
scene christmaskaraoke25
: You’re sure askin’ me a lot of questions tonight, Sensei. You sure you don’t wanna shoot some of ‘em Sana’s way as well?
: I just mean with all of the noise. It’s pretty loud in here and you seem fine.
scene christmaskaraoke26
: O-Oh! You mean with that...
: Yeah, I’m doin’ okay. Makoto and I got here a little after everybody else, so I haven’t been puttin’ up with it for long.
: Don’t know what that means for later, but...I’m all good right now. Peachy as a...peach.
: Where is Makoto, actually? It’s rare to see you two separated at parties and I haven’t seen her yet.
scene christmaskaraoke27
: I...umm...think she went into the bedroom with...Nodoka and...Miss Imai.
: I was really worried about the context of that sentence until you said Imani was there, too.
Now, I’m just even more excited.
Just kidding.

I don’t know how Imani feels about sexual contact with students, but I’m hoping her opinion isn’t too far off from mine or it might be a little too hard for the two of us to really understand one another.
: Wait, why is Imani here? Who invited her?
: Do you not want her to be here or somethin’, Sensei?
: Think she might get in the way of you spendin’ some alone time with my BFF or somethin’?
: I’m just surprised she came on such short notice. Or...how she even knew about it in the first place.
: You...know you can just...ask her...right?
: I’m really not liking your attitude tonight, Sana.
scene christmaskaraoke28
: Wh-What attitude?! I haven’t done anything!
: Are you raising your voice at me right now?
: No! Yes! I don’t know!
: Sana, I’m really going to need you to calm down.
scene christmaskaraoke29
: Mm!
: Sensei! The heck do ya think you’re doin’?! You made Sana cry and you’ve only been here for like ten minutes!
: Sana, why are you crying? I thought it was obvious I was just kidding.
: I...just am!
: It’s no big deal!
: Do you need me to-
: No thank you!
: But I didn’t even-
: Sensei, let me field this one. You go hang out with Makoto and maybe plant a big wet one on those luscious lips of hers right in front of the new teacher.
: Really just assert your dominance. Alpha style.
: Great idea, Miku. I’m sure randomly kissing someone like that wouldn’t have any repercussions whatsoever.
scene christmaskaraoke30
: What do drums have to do with this?! Get over there and mingle, coach! Do what ya came here to do! Talk to girls and conquer hearts!
scene black
: Fine. But I’m only doing this because it’ll make it look like you made Sana cry instead of me.
: Ain’t nobody gonna think that, Sen-
: Miku! Why is Sana crying?! What did you do?!
: I...ahh! Crap!
: Sensei! Come back!
Farewell, Miku.
Hello, everyone else.
